name: master-key
description: Master your keybindings with documentation, discoverability, modal bindings, macros and expressive configuration

walkthroughs.title: Master Key Customization
walkthroughs.description: Start using Master Key's powerful keybinding tools

steps.title: Activate a Preset
steps.description: Insert a pre-defined set of keybindings into your key map.

steps.title: Install Preset Extensions
steps.description: Install the pre-specified set of extensions your preset requires to work properly.

steps.title: Review Documentation
steps.description: Review the documentation of the preset you activated to understand the keybindings you've defined.

steps.title: Edit Preset
steps.description: You can create your own bindings by editing a copy of a preset

steps.title: Activate Preset Edits
steps.description: Once you have opened a copy of the present, customize it to your own needs, and activate the file to make the necessary changes to your keybindings.

commands.title: Toggle automatic display of command suggestions in sidebar
Toggle Visual Doc Modifier by frequency

master-key.layoutIndependence.title: Use Layout Independent Bindings
master-key.layoutIndependence.description: When enabled, bindings do not match the keys on your keyboard, instead matching the keys on the default US layout.

master-key.maxCommandHistory.title: Command History Maximum
master-key.maxCommandHistory.description: The maximum number of previously run commands that are saved.

master-key.ignorePresetUpdates.title: Ignore Preset Updates
master-key.ignorePresetUpdates.description: When enabled, the user will not be notified of any updates to Mater Key's keybinding presets.

master-key.suggestionDelay.title: Suggestion Delay
master-key.suggestionDelay.description: Time to wait, in milliseconds, before showing command suggestions for multi-key commands. Command suggestion must be enabled for this setting to apply.

master-key.commandSuggestionsEnabled.title: Enable Command Suggestions
master-key.commandSuggestionsEnabled.description: When set, command suggestions will be displayed after a delay during a multi-key sequence.

master-key.keyDisplayDelay.title: Key Display Delay
master-key.keyDisplayDelay.description: Time to wait, in milliseconds, before clearing status bar display of the most recently pressed key sequence. (set to 0 to hide display entirely)

master-key.searchMatchBackground.title: Background of current search match
master-key.searchMatchBackground.description: A html format color styling to highlight the current search match(if left blank defaults to built-in search style).

master-key.searchMatchBorder.title: Border of current search match
master-key.searchMatchBorder.description: A html format color styling for the border of the current search match (if left blank defaults to built-in search style).

master-key.searchOtherMatchesBackground.title: Background of non-current search matches
master-key.searchOtherMatchesBackground.description: A html format color styling to highlight other search matches (if left blank defaults to built-in search style).

master-key.searchOtherMatchesBorder.title: Border of non-current search matches
master-key.searchOtherMatchesBorder.description: A html format color styling for the border of other search matches (if left blank defaults to built-in search style).
